summary: The marketing team is in a critical push to launch the Intelligent China webpage this week and finalize the Knowledge website redesign, while aligning behind Asia Star and Intelligent China as the top program priorities for global lead generation.
summaryDetail: The most urgent item is the launch of the Intelligent China webpage, which is due this week and is central to the team's newly aligned priority on China-focused programs. In parallel, the Knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team has chosen the current design as the base with selective editorial inspiration, and Joseph, Julie, and the lead need to hold a 30-minute working session to mark specific feedback before Joker implements changes. The global marketing strategy now prioritizes Asia Star and Intelligent China for visibility and lead generation, with US partner programs (Berkeley, Stanford, Columbia) treated as secondary and paused for the first quarter; Joseph is drafting target-audience and prompt documents and building Asia Star participant profiles to support this. This week also requires resolving the Outlook account lockout by deleting and re-adding accounts on all devices and confirming backend access with JSB, and the team must audit Google Ads conversion tracking to ensure accurate measurement. Looking ahead, the team should prepare for the APEC event with Prof. Tao confirmed for Nov 13, publish the LEED Platinum press release after fact-checking, and manage follow-ups on the TIA luncheon, SSEF sub-forum, and BritCham membership renewal.

decisions.text: Stale saved passwords on devices are the cause of repeated account lockouts
Remove the standalone videos section; videos will be dispersed by topic instead.
Keep the two-menu structure with the School menu at top and Knowledge menu, favoring a centered Knowledge menu.
Bring BCI (and BSI) index banners into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Use the current Knowledge design as the base, taking selected inspiration from Joseph's editorial-style layout rather than adopting it wholesale.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; treat US partner programs as secondary.
Consider Berkeley as a possible third priority and include it in the audit phase.
Put US partnerships on hold for the first quarter to focus on China programs.
